provenance.extraction_invocation: uv run python -m code_extension.slice --scenario addressing-runner --oakridge <oakridge> (git show 1495ec34d63a3147c60203ec7877cc2667212e93:<path> for each file the scenario's module in code_extension/library/ lists)
extraction_rules: Ship the pinned import closure of the files the feature passes through, and the pinned tests that exercise them.
Keep hidden checks, patches and qualification assets outside repository/.
licenses: Oakridge is private source at the pinned commit; no standalone license file is present.
The locked third-party packages carry their notices in package-lock.json.
local_adaptations: Only relative import paths change, as each file moves; the slice spec lists every edit.

The pinned grading fixture opens a scratch Postgres database; the one value the shipped tests read from it, the pilot pinned expectations, is replaced by an authored helper that gives every catalogue question the same expectation.
Two literal NUL bytes in the producer's template strings are written as the \u0000 escape, which is the same runtime string, so a submission that edits the file is not refused as binary.
Pinned tests that point at the non-local edit move to the hidden regression group.
An authored hidden regression test pins the coverage link view's bytes and digests, because evidence-set digests depend on them.

public_requirements: The catalogue pins analysis.finding_addressing: a boolean question over analysis findings with the stated assessment-window recipe.
runnerEntry("addressing") returns a code entry without network, and grading can name it.
runPackages packages each analysis finding with an addressing link view, its own reference and the updates that address it, and the runner answers true exactly when an update addresses the finding.
The runner counts only addresses links whose target names the finding's artifact kind, item kind, scope and local id.
The runner refuses a non-boolean question, a question without an assessment_window build, and a view that is not an addressing link view.
